title: Oracle to cut thousands of jobs, Amazon strikes deal with Delta
title_zh: 甲骨文裁员数千人，亚马逊与达美航空达成协议
summary: Yahoo Finance Host Josh Lipton tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including Business Insider reporting that Oracle (ORCL) will layoff thousands of jobs and Amazon (AMZN) striking a satellite deal with Delta Air Lines (DAL).Stay u...
summary_zh: 雅虎财经主持人乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 在本《市场分钟》中追踪今日走势最强劲的股票和最大的市场故事，其中包括《商业内幕》(Business Insider) 报道甲骨文 (ORCL) 将裁员数千人以及亚马逊 (AMZN) 与达美航空 (DAL) 达成卫星协议。

title: McCormick Acquires Unilever Food Arm in $44.8 Billion Merger
title_zh: 味好美以 448 亿美元合并收购联合利华食品部门
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Unilever Plc agreed to combine its food business with spice maker McCormick & Co.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——联合利华公司同意将其食品业务与香料制造商味好美公司合并。

title: CoreWeave shares rise on $8.5B financing deal
title_zh: CoreWeave 股价因 $8.5B 融资交易而上涨
summary: CoreWeave (NASDAQ:CRWV) announced that it has closed an $8.5 billion delayed draw term loan facility, marking a first-of-its-kind investment-grade financing backed by GPU infrastructure.
summary_zh: CoreWeave（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）宣布已完成一项 85 亿美元的延迟提取定期贷款融资，这是首笔由 GPU 基础设施支持的投资级融资。

title: Amazon inks satellite internet deal with Delta in major win over Elon Musk's SpaceX
title_zh: 亚马逊与达美航空签署卫星互联网协议，击败埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX
summary: Amazon is teaming up with Delta to bring its satellite internet to hundreds of flights by 2028.
summary_zh: 亚马逊正与达美航空合作，到 2028 年将其卫星互联网覆盖数百个航班。

title: Carlyle Ups Stake in MAI Capital with Majority Acquisition
title_zh: 凯雷通过收购多数股权增持 MAI Capital 股份
summary: Private equity firm Carlyle has agreed to acquire $72.6B MAI Capital from Galway Holdings at a valuation of $2.8 billion.
summary_zh: 私募股权公司凯雷已同意以 28 亿美元的估值从戈尔韦控股公司收购价值 72.6B 美元的 MAI Capital。
